# XYZTile

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Configure a raster XYZ tile source from a URL template (\{z\}/\{x\}/\{y\}).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/xyz-tile",
  "type": "XYZTileOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/xyz-tile').par.url` (an input) and `op('/xyz-tile').out.sourceConfig` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.url`, `out.sourceConfig`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `url` | `StringField` | `"https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"` |
| `subdomains` | `StringField` | `"abc"` |
| `tileSize` | `NumberField` | `256` |
| `minZoom` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `maxZoom` | `NumberField` | `19` |
| `attribution` | `StringField` | `""` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `sourceConfig` | `UnknownField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
